chapter: Depression years and New Orleans trumpeters
title: Did Emmett Hardy use a mute? Turk Rene
summary: After a mention of a tape, they discuss whether Hardy used a mute for wah-wah effects and Brownlee praises trumpeter Turk Rene.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Growl, plunger and derby: the trumpet mute tradition

blocks.x: You know, we do have a little tape with Pansy Lane, Doc,
Shouldn't say that in front of Papa and Mama Lane. But, uh, Doc Sushan gave it to us. He made it with him for his pass.
Uh, but, uh, I wanted to ask you, did Emmett Hardy ever use a mute to get this Wawa sign?
Not in the beginning, no. No, he did not. But then, then, uh, I don't know whether it was Turk René.
Oh, I know who you're talking about. The colored guy, yeah.
You never hear too much said about the Turk. But if ever you see Louis Armstrong, you ask him about the Turk.
